Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE 
 V_CNT NUMBER; 
 V_COUNT NUMBER; 
 V_ARAB_PASS_FULL_NM VARCHAR2(240);
 V_DOC_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_PSPRT_NBR VARCHAR2(15);
 V_PSPRT_CTRY_CD NUMBER;
 V_NATLTY_CD NUMBER;
 V_PSNGR_MOBILE VARCHAR2(20);
BEGIN 
IF :PRTL_PASS_SEQ IS NOT NULL THEN 

 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT 
 FROM PRTL_PSNGR_TRIPS
 WHERE PRTL_PASS_SEQ = :PRTL_PASS_SEQ; 
 IF V_CNT > 0 THEN 
 --------------------------------
 SELECT ARAB_PASS_FULL_NM,
 DOC_TYPE,
 PSPRT_NBR,
 PSPRT_CTRY_CD,
 NATLTY_CD,
 PSNGR_MOBILE
 INTO 
 V_ARAB_PASS_FULL_NM,
 V_DOC_TYPE,
 V_PSPRT_NBR,
 V_PSPRT_CTRY_CD,
 V_NATLTY_CD,
 V_PSNGR_MOBILE 
 FROM PRTL_PSNGR_TRIPS
 WHERE PRTL_PASS_SEQ = :PRTL_PASS_SEQ
 AND port_cd=:parameter.p_port_cd ;
 --------------------****************************---------------------------- 
 
 
 SELECT COUNT(*) 
 INTO V_COUNT 
 FROM importers
 where BUS_ID_TYPE_CD=V_DOC_TYPE 
 and bus_id = V_PSPRT_NBR
 and impr_type_cd=4 
 AND port_cd=:parameter.p_port_cd ;
 
 IF V_COUNT >0 THEN 
 
select IMPR_NBR,
CTRY_CD,
CTRY_CD_OF_ID,
ARBC_IMPR_NAME,
MOBILE_NO ,
IMPR_TYPE_CD,
bus_id
into 
:IMPR_NBR,
:CTRY_CD,
:CTRY_CD_OF_ID,
:ARBC_IMPR_NAME,
:b_MOBILE_NO,
:BUS_ID_TYPE_CD,
:BUS_ID
from importers 
where port_cd=:parameter.p_port_cd 
 and impr_type_cd=4 
 and BUS_ID_TYPE_CD=V_DOC_TYPE 
 and bus_id=V_PSPRT_NBR;
 
 ELSE 
 :ARBC_IMPR_NAME := V_ARAB_PASS_FULL_NM;
 :BUS_ID_TYPE_CD := V_DOC_TYPE;
 :BUS_ID := V_PSPRT_NBR;
 :CTRY_CD_OF_ID := V_PSPRT_CTRY_CD;
 :CTRY_CD := V_NATLTY_CD;
 :B_MOBILE_NO := V_PSNGR_MOBILE; 
 
 END IF; 
 ----------------------****************************------------------
 IF :BUS_ID_TYPE_CD IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF :BUS_ID_TYPE_CD = 2 then
 str.dispalert('لا يسمح بهذا النوع','error');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
SELECT BUS_ID_TYPE_NAME INTO :BUS_ID_TYPE_NAME FROM BUS_ID_TYPES
WHERE BUS_ID_TYPE_CD=:BUS_ID_TYPE_CD; 
if :BUS_ID_TYPE_CD in (3,5) then
 :CTRY_CD_OF_ID := 100;
 SELECT CRTY_ARBC_NAME INTO :CTRY_CD_OF_ID_NAME FROM COUNTRIES WHERE CTRY_CD=:CTRY_CD_OF_ID;
end if;
END IF; 
 
 
IF :CTRY_CD_OF_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
SELECT CRTY_ARBC_NAME 
INTO :CTRY_CD_OF_ID_NAME 
FROM COUNTRIES WHERE 
CTRY_CD=:CTRY_CD_OF_ID;
END IF;
 
 
 IF :CTRY_CD IS NOT NULL THEN
SELECT CRTY_ARBC_NAME INTO :CRTY_ARBC_NAME FROM COUNTRIES WHERE CTRY_CD=:CTRY_CD;
END IF;
 ------------------------------------
 ELSE 
 str.dispalert( 'الرقم المرجعي المدخل غير موجود','information');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF; 

--if :PRTL_PASS_SEQ is not null then
-- str.dispalert('يجب ادخال خطة التصرف بعد الطباعة حيث يتم تسجيل نشاط بذالك','information');
--end if;
----------------------****************-----------------------REPORT------------
CHECK_VAL;
---------------*REPORT*-------------
END IF; 

 END;

 RET NUMBER;
BEGIN

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);

 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');

 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,

 :IMPR_TYPE_NAME := :GLOBAL.IMPR_TYPE_NAME;
 :BUS_ID_TYPE_CD := :GLOBAL.BUS_ID_TYPE_CD;
 :BUS_ID_TYPE_NAME := :GLOBAL.BUS_ID_TYPE_NAME;
 :GLOBAL.VALID :=1;
 GO_ITEM('BUS_ID');
 ELSE
 :IMPR_TYPE_CD := NULL;
 :IMPR_TYPE_NAME := NULL;
 :BUS_ID_TYPE_CD := NULL;
 :BUS_ID_TYPE_NAME := NULL;
 END IF;
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already EXISTS!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Adjust_Height IS
 V_HEIGHT number;
 SHIFT number;
 V_ROW_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_TEMP NUMBER;
BEGIN
 V_ROW_COUNT := NVL(:PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT, 1);
 IF V_ROW_COUNT < 1 THEN
 V_ROW_COUNT := 1;
 ELSIF V_ROW_COUNT > 12 THEN
 V_ROW_COUNT := 12;
 END IF;

 V_HEIGHT := Get_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT);
 SHIFT := (12 - V_ROW_COUNT) * 0.25;
 V_HEIGHT := V_HEIGHT - SHIFT;

 :PARAMETER.BUTTON_Y_POS := :PARAMETER.BUTTON_Y_POS - SHIFT;

 Set_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT);
 Set_Canvas_Property('CG$PAGE_1', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT);
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('BUTTONS', display_position, 0, :PARAMETER.BUTTON_Y_POS);

 IF :PARAMETER.P_MSG_DTLS IS NOT NULL AND :PARAMETER.P_MESS_TXT IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_TEMP := (V_HEIGHT - 1) * 0.35;
 Set_Item_Property('MESSAGE', HEIGHT, V_TEMP);
 V_TEMP := V_TEMP + 0.1 + Get_Item_Property('MESS_TEXT.MESSAGE', Y_POS);
 Set_Item_Property('MSG_DTLS', Y_POS, V_TEMP);
 Set_Item_Property('MSG_DTLS', HEIGHT, (V_HEIGHT - 1) * 0.65);
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_MESS_TXT IS NOT NULL THEN
 Set_Item_Property('MESSAGE', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT - 0.9);
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_MSG_DTLS IS NOT NULL THEN
 Set_Item_Property('MSG_DTLS', Y_POS, TO_NUMBER(GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('MESSAGE', Y_POS)));
 Set_Item_Property('MSG_DTLS', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT - 0.9);
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADJUST_WIDTH
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Adjust_Width IS
 Shift number;
 V_MARGIN number;
 ENTER_POS number;
 EXECUTE_POS number;
 OK_POS number;
 CANCEL_POS number;

BEGIN
 if :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH < 4 then
 str.DispAlert('عرض الرسـالة أقل من الحد المسموح به','INFORMATION');
 elsif :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH > 7.5 then
 str.DispAlert('عرض الرسـالة أكبر من الحد المسموح به','INFORMATION');
 else
 Shift := 1.75 - ((:PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH - 4)/2);
 IF (GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('PB_CANCEL',VISIBLE) = 'TRUE') THEN
 CANCEL_POS:= Get_Item_Property('PB_CANCEL', X_POS);
 END IF;
 IF (GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('PB_OK',VISIBLE) = 'TRUE') THEN 
 OK_POS := Get_Item_Property('PB_OK', X_POS);
 END IF; 

 IF (GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('PB_CANCEL',VISIBLE) = 'TRUE') THEN
 Set_Item_Property('PB_CANCEL', X_POS, CANCEL_POS-Shift); 
 END IF;
 IF (GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('PB_OK',VISIBLE) = 'TRUE') THEN 
 Set_Item_Property('PB_OK', X_POS, OK_POS-Shift); 
 END IF;

 Set_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', WIDTH, :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH);
 Set_Canvas_Property('CG$PAGE_1', WIDTH, :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH); 

 V_MARGIN := 2*:PARAMETER.P_MESS_X_POS;
 IF :PARAMETER.P_MESS_TXT IS NOT NULL THEN
 Set_Item_Property('MESSAGE', X_POS, :PARAMETER.P_MESS_X_POS);
 Set_Item_Property('MESSAGE', WIDTH, :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH - V_MARGIN);
 END IF;

 IF :PARAMETER.P_MSG_DTLS IS NOT NULL THEN
 Set_Item_Property('MSG_DTLS', X_POS, :PARAMETER.P_MESS_X_POS);
 Set_Item_Property('MSG_DTLS', WIDTH, :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH - V_MARGIN);
 END IF;
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_IDNO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CHECK_IDNO(ID_NO VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER IS

RESULT NUMBER:=0;
SU NUMBER:=0;
CHR_RESULT VARCHAR2(10);
Cur_ID_No VARCHAR2(15);
BEGIN
 Cur_ID_No := ID_NO;
 IF length (Cur_ID_No) =10 THEN
 FOR I IN 1..9 LOOP
 SU :=TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(Cur_ID_No,I,1));
 IF MOD(I,2)<>0 THEN
 RESULT:=RESULT + MOD(SU * 2,10);
 RESULT:=RESULT + TRUNC((SU * 2)/10);
 ELSE
 RESULT:=RESULT + SU;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 CHR_RESULT:=RESULT;

 IF SUBSTR(Cur_ID_No,10,1)=0 THEN
 IF SUBSTR(CHR_RESULT,LENGTH(CHR_RESULT),1)=0 THEN
 RETURN 1;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF TO_CHAR((10 - TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(CHR_RESULT,LENGTH(CHR_RESULT),1))))=SUBSTR(Cur_ID_No,10,1) THEN
 RETURN 1;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN 0;
 ELSE
 RETURN -2; -- Length of ID <> 10
 END IF; 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 RETURN -1; -- Any error 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: IS_DIGIT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION IS_Digit(txt_num VARCHAR2) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 chr1 VARCHAR2(200);
 len_txt NUMBER ;
 counter NUMBER :=1;

BEGIN
 len_txt:=LENGTH(txt_num);
 WHILE (counter<=len_txt) LOOP
 chr1 := SUBSTR(txt_num,counter,1) ;
 IF ASCII(chr1) <48 OR ASCII(chr1)>57 THEN
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;
 counter :=counter+1;
 END LOOP;
 RETURN TRUE;
END;

 GO_ITEM('BUS_ID_TYPE_CD');
 ELSE
 GO_ITEM('CARR_PREFIX');
 END IF; 
END;
end if;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE 
 errnum NUMBER := ERROR_CODE; 
 errtxt VARCHAR2(80) := ERROR_TEXT; 
 errtyp VARCHAR2(20) := ERROR_TYPE; 
 alert_is alert; 
 alert_button number;
 MsgTxt VARCHAR2(2000);
 
 BEGIN 
 IF errnum = 41051 then
 null;
 else
 IF errtyp = 'FRM' THEN
 errtyp := 'خطأ : ش';
 ELSIF errtyp = 'ORA' THEN
 errtyp := 'خطأ : ق';
 END IF;
 
 MsgTxt := errtyp||'-'||TO_CHAR(errnum)||': '||errtxt;
 alert_is := find_alert('CFG_ERROR'); 
 
 if (not id_null(alert_is)) then 
 set_alert_property(alert_is, ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT, MsgTxt ); 
 alert_button := show_alert(alert_is); 
 else
 Message(MsgTxt); 
 end if;
 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
end if;
 END;

Trigger.Name: ON-MESSAGE
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE 
 msgnum NUMBER := MESSAGE_CODE; 
 msgtxt VARCHAR2(80) := MESSAGE_TEXT; 
 msgtyp VARCHAR2(20) := MESSAGE_TYPE; 
 BEGIN
 IF msgtyp = 'FRM' THEN
 msgtyp := 'معلومه : ش';
 ELSIF msgtyp = 'ORA' THEN
 msgtyp := 'معلومه : ق';
 END IF;
 
 
 Message(msgtyp||'-'||TO_CHAR(msgnum)||': '||msgtxt); 

 END;

Trigger.Name: PRE-FORM
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGYR$SET_DATE_FORMAT */
/* Establish Single Standard Format Mask with 4-digit-year element */
BEGIN
 set_application_property(DATE_FORMAT_COMPATIBILITY_MODE, '5.0');
 set_application_property(PLSQL_DATE_FORMAT, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS');
 set_application_property(BUILTIN_DATE_FORMAT, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS');
 forms_ddl('ALTER SESSION SET NLS_DATE_FORMAT = ''YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS''');
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-EXIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
Default_Value(0 ,'GLOBAL.OK');

IF :GLOBAL.OK = 1 THEN
 EXIT_FORM;
ELSE
 :GLOBAL.SUSP := 1;
 CANCEL_FORM;
 EXIT_FORM(NO_VALIDATE);
END IF;
